RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making sex discrimination virtually impossible to substantiate. An all-male panel selecting one male candidate over another provides no evidence of sex-based bias against you. 

Raising the panel's gender composition would damage your professional credibility. For a head of group position, consultancies frequently prioritize commercial acumen and client relationships over additional years of technical experience. 

Instead, follow up courteously on your request for feedback. Frame your inquiry around leadership, business development, and client management skills to gain constructive insight into how you can strengthen future applications.
